preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 2 and 500 characters.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(len(input_string)) for j in range(i+2, len(input_string)+1) if input_string[i:j] == input_string[i:j][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of palindromic substrings of length 2 or more in the input string.
